scope.summary: Expand the sculpt brush set on the MT-356 sculpt delta layer (CG-17, MD Sculpt mode): wrinkle/release brush (dynamic wrinkle direction), stamp brush with alpha textures, and pinch brush, with tablet-pressure parameter pass-through, all writing to the existing non-destructive sculpt delta layer per Section 13.6.
acceptance_criteria: wrinkle brush: directional micro-fold displacement along stroke with release (smooth-back) mode; stamp brush: alpha-texture height stamping (grayscale image asset); pinch brush: tangential convergence toward stroke line.
All brushes write to the MT-356 delta layer (re-unfurl and revert unaffected); brush params (size, strength, falloff, pressure scalar) typed and identical across GUI + MCP surface.
Argus evidence: before/after capture of a stamped + wrinkled region; stable author_ids on new brush controls.
scope.risk_if_missed: Hero-frame detailing (memory folds, stress wrinkles) needs the full brush set; with only push/pull/smooth the sculpt layer cannot replace MD sculpt mode for production stills.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Solver/backend/schema producer only. It exposes typed state, diagnostics, receipts, and TraceProjection; the named native workspace owner consumes it without widening this MT's allowed paths.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Pattern authoring, sewing, and arrangement

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.
